items.title: 2.8.2 Periodic table ke elements ki classification (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.8.2, printed pages 39-40, with Quick Check 2.6 and answers.

blocks.text: Main-group ya representative elements sab ki valence shell configuration nsᵃ npᵇ hoti hai, jahan ‘a’ aur ‘b’ alag ho sakte hain. Yani in mein bahar wala ‘s’ ya ‘p’ subshell bhar raha hai. d-block transition elements mein ‘d’ subshell, aur f-block (inner-transition) elements mein ‘f’ subshell bhar raha hai.

Periodic table mein elements par aage barhte hue subshells bharne ka ek pakka pattern hai. Isi se building-up order (bharne ki tarteeb) likhi ja sakti hai. Figure 2.16 periodic table ka sketch hai jo elements ke blocks dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Periodic table ka drawing, har block ki har qataar par ek label: neela s block, groups 1 aur 18 ke oopar 1s aur 2s se 7s qataarein; peela d block 3d, 4d, 5d aur 6d; hara p block 2p se 7p; f block ki do alag qataarein 4f aur 5f. Periods 6 aur 7 ke group 3 mein * aur ** ke nishan 4f aur 5f qataaron ki taraf ishara karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.16: Modern periodic table jis mein s, p, d aur f block elements dikhaye gaye hain (kitab ki Figure 2.16 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 2.16 mein 6d row saat boxes par ruk jati hai aur 7p row hai hi nahi, halanke kitab ki apni Figures 1.1 aur 2.15 mein elements 104 se 118 maujood hain. Upar ki drawing mein 6d aur 7p dono rows poori hain.
Figure 2.16 yahi pattern dikhati hai: neele hisse mein ‘ns’ subshell bhar raha hai, hare hisse mein np, peele hisse mein (n – 1)d, aur halke sunehri hisse mein (n – 2)f.

Building-up order pehle period se shuru karein, jis mein ‘1s’ bharta hai. Doosre period mein ‘2s’, phir usi period mein aage jump kar ke ‘2p’. Teesre period mein ‘3s’ aur ‘3p’; chauthe mein ‘4s’, ‘3d’ aur phir ‘4p’. Periodic table saamne ho to yeh pattern aasani se samajh aata hai.

Elements ki classification (darja bandi) metals, non-metals, representative aur transition elements, periods, groups aur blocks (s, p, d, f) mein ki gayi hai. Yeh sab electronic configuration aur valence electrons ki basis (bunyaad) par hai, is liye har qism ke elements ki chemical properties aasani se samjhi ja sakti hain.

blocks.caption: Kaun sa subshell bhar raha hai

blocks.prompt: a) Configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d¹⁰ 4s² 4p⁶ 4d¹⁰ 5s² 5p⁵ wala element: (i) kaun sa block (ii) group (iii) period (iv) kaun sa element?
blocks.explanation: Aakhri electron 5p mein hai: (i) p block. Bahar wale shell mein 5s² 5p⁵ = 7 electrons: (ii) group 17. Sab se bara shell 5: (iii) period 5. (iv) Iodine (I, Z = 53).

blocks.prompt: b) 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d⁵ 4s¹ wala element kis block ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Is mein 3d subshell bhar raha hai, is liye d block (transition element). Yeh chromium (Z = 24) hai.

items: Representative: ns aur np; transition: (n − 1)d; inner-transition: (n − 2)f.
